# AI Video Studio

> An open-source bring-your-own-key AI video production studio.

AI Video Studio is an open-source video production studio that works with OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible LLMs. Users bring their own API key and go from idea to storyboard, assets, timeline, and export in one place.
It is built for creators and developers who want control over their own models and keys while producing AI videos.

Built by Aditya Pratap: https://adityapratapjhansi.vercel.app/about.html
